decisions.reason: After two years without visible market presence, premium customer support likely fell short as a distinct paid offer relative to aspiration and is better folded into the core service model.

The version management tool fits the firm's capabilities, but its disappearance from the website suggests standalone demand stayed below aspiration and the capability is better reused inside the hosting platform.

Because this contract tool is the most distant from the core business and is no longer visible, it is the clearest case for reallocating resources after an exploratory product likely underperformed aspiration.
Scalable hosting for agencies is a flagship close to the firm's core offer and strategic direction, so in a growing market it is likely to meet aspiration and remain on the market.
